text:
- **Project overview order:** The overview now lists open projects first. Closed projects appear in one collapsed section at the bottom.
- **Repo feedback for agents:** Agents can give feedback on the repo itself. The change passed CI and waits for owner review.
- **Project search retrieval:** Work started on a second retrieval model for project search. It ranks whole records. An offline eval will compare it with the current search.
- **Cross-repo PR review:** A delivery report records how to close a PR review in another repo. Checking that flow started.
